thread:
alina: T-minus 45 until the change window. Enabling freeze now. Quick checklist — keep replies short:
• pin canary to v2.4.1
• pause noncritical batch jobs
• start smoke suite (50 reqs)
• set rollback thresholds and alerting
Ping when each item is done.

samir: On it — pinning canary now.

deploy-bot: [action] POST /pins -> env=canary model=v2.4.1 — success (id=pin-202503) :white_check_mark:

maria: Smoke started (50 reqs). Running basic lat/err checks.

ken: Rollback thresholds proposed: error rate >5% sustained for 2m OR p95 latency >800ms for 5m. If triggered -> immediate rollback to v2.3.7. Also add a manual abort gate.

alina: Confirmed. Documented in runbook under "canary rollback". Manual abort remains with release lead.

ops-oncall: Alerting updated to match thresholds. Pager rules set; Grafana panel pinned. I'll be monitoring latency/error panels.

samir: Disabled nightly-embeds cron in prod and staging.

devops-bot: Command executed: `cron disable nightly-embeds` — success.

maria: Canary warmup looks clean, memory and CPU stable, no OOMs.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted -> 5% (steady for 3m).

alina: Good. If all metrics remain green, we'll go to 25% at T+10m. Reminder: do NOT merge release notes until freeze lifted.

ken: Added a short rollback playbook note: drain tasks, set traffic=0, run `/rollback-service --env canary --to v2.3.7`, confirm logs/metrics, then promote fallback. Keep #postmortems in loop.

ops-oncall: Copy. Pager on standby. I left a short watch script on my laptop to poll p95 and error rate.

maria: 10m smoke done — all green across endpoints tested. Ready for 25%.

samir: Approving traffic increase.

deploy-bot: Traffic set -> 25% (steady).

alina: Nice. We plan full rollout after another 20m of stability. Calendar freeze set and invite updated. If rollback needed, follow Ken's playbook and ping me + ops-oncall.

maria: One small note — embedding worker queue depth rose to 40% briefly but recovered. Keeping an eye.

samir: All jobs that could blast infra during rollout are paused.

devops-bot: Reminder: to rollback use `/rollback-service --env prod --to v2.3.7` and then `unpin model v2.4.1` if needed.

alina: Thank you team — thumbs up if you're watching the charts :thumbsup:

ken: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Watching now.

maria: Green across the board at 25%. Proceeding to warmup for full window.

samir: Copy, standing by for final.
